But what separates #LongCOVID patients with PEM and others who have post COVID syndromes?

It's likely a cytokine storm fighting infections. Rapamycin/sirolimus deactivates the cytokine storm by weakening the immune system. The NK cell counts are already low, so they're already immunocompromised.

This explains why most #LongCOVID patients have an activated W-HERV ENV retrovirus in their blood plasma.

Since everyone has the HERV-W retrovirus in their genome, everyone is vulnerable to developing Long COVID. It's just another infection or two away.
